goal: Populate global extended public keys in PSBTs generated from multi-key wallet descriptors.
Allows stateless hardware signers like BitBox02 to verify multisig setups and sign transactions.
reviewability: Wait for author response to open objections, and branch needs rebase.
agreement: Unaddressed objection: should handle descriptors and PSBTs generically rather than multisig-only (achow101)
Unaddressed objection: MuSig descriptors omit participant extended public keys (achow101)
Nonblocking objection: API should return a map directly without requiring SigningProvider (achow101)
Requested PR description clarifications and noted potential use for non-HWI flows (Sjors)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes an interoperability failure where stateless hardware signers refuse to sign multisig
PSBTs when global extended public keys are missing.
